notes.title: Save file fix
notes.notes: Save files had an internal issue that has been fixed

notes.title: Bosses added to end game reset
notes.notes: Not all bosses would reset at the end of the game. Now upon completion of the game all bosses reset and can be fought again from the beginning of the game while upgrades carry over.

notes.title: Sewer bug fix
notes.notes: There was a point in the sewers where after saving being hit by a hazzard would bug the player. It has been fixed.

notes.title: Buff Huckem coming soon
notes.notes: Buff Huckem Fully Wrecked will launch October 19th 2023.
